title: The first man to The Rock, through a Vatican fresco
description:
Raphael's Disputa, the line of popes and a 1980 Vatican visit connect the first man in the Bible to Dwayne Johnson.

Adam → Pope Sixtus IV → Pope John Paul II → Joe Biden → Ash Carter → Kevin Hart → The Rock

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
